altText: Explain the nature of God as the Creator.
detailedDescription: Illustration showing creation (people, trees, animals, water bodies) to represent God as originator of all things, in a respectful classroom-friendly style.

altText: Identify the uniqueness of humankind from other creatures.
detailedDescription: Illustration comparing humans with animals/plants highlighting unique abilities like thinking, speaking, and moral choice, using simple visual comparison.

altText: Discuss the effects of human activities on the environment.
detailedDescription: Illustration showing harmful activities (e.g., pollution, deforestation, illegal mining) and their effects (dirty water, floods, heat) in a non-graphic educational style.

altText: Name the various forms of worship.
detailedDescription: Illustration showing different forms of worship (prayer, singing, reading scripture, congregational gathering) represented respectfully and inclusively.

altText: State the purpose of worship in the three main religions.
detailedDescription: Illustration showing worship as communication with God, obedience, thanksgiving, and drawing closer, in a simple classroom-friendly scene.

altText: Differentiate between religious and non-religious songs.
detailedDescription: Illustration contrasting religious songs (faith-themed) and non-religious songs (everyday topics) using music notes and two labeled groups of singers.
Illustration showing community festival scenes (gathering, drumming, dancing, food, worship) in a respectful, inclusive style.

altText: Describe the call of the religious leaders.
detailedDescription: Illustration representing the idea of a religious calling/mission (guidance, leadership, service), depicted symbolically and respectfully without sensitive detail.

altText: Explain the need to be committed to God.
detailedDescription: Illustration showing commitment through prayer, service, caring for others and the environment, and consistent good conduct.
Illustration showing good deeds (helping, sharing, honesty, obedience, kindness) and positive recognition (praise/certificate) in a school/community setting.

altText: Give reasons for rewarding good deeds.
detailedDescription: Illustration showing rewards encouraging good behaviour, law and order, and moral development—e.g., teacher praising a student for doing right.

altText: Explain authority at home, school and in the community.
detailedDescription: Illustration showing authority figures across home/school/community (parents, teachers, prefects, chiefs/elders, faith leaders) in a respectful style.

altText: Discuss the importance of being a committed member of the family.
detailedDescription: Illustration showing a committed family member helping with chores, respecting elders, participating in family activities, and supporting relatives.
